review.tagline: Python SDK for multi-agent workflows with handoffs, guardrails and tracing
review.summary: Python library from OpenAI for building agents with instructions, tools, guardrails and handoffs between agents. It supports the OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions APIs and, per the README, 100+ other LLMs. It also includes sandbox agents, realtime and voice agents, sessions for conversation history, human-in-the-loop controls and built-in tracing.
review.audience: Python developers building tool-using or multi-agent LLM apps
strengths: Small API: Agent and Runner cover a text agent in a few lines
Tools can be Python functions, MCP servers or hosted tools
Built-in tracing, guardrails, sessions and human-in-the-loop support
Includes sandbox, realtime and voice agents; MIT license, Python 3.10+
weaknesses: Examples assume OPENAI_API_KEY; non-OpenAI models go through optional LiteLLM or any-llm
Pull requests limited to repository collaborators
Python only; JS/TS version is a separate repository
Realtime agents use gpt-realtime-2.1, an OpenAI-hosted model
needs: Needs OpenAI API key, Python 3.10+, optional: Redis, optional: SQLAlchemy, optional: websockets, optional: LiteLLM or any-llm, optional: Docker
Models: OpenAI Responses API, OpenAI Chat Completions API, 100+ other LLMs via LiteLLM or any-llm
